aiReview.method: Direct translation from complete Japanese-only packet. All paragraph text, lesson metadata and question prompts/options/rationales/readings compared to source, then Chinese read as connected prose. No other locale or public translation service.
specificChecks: Sleep stages preserve non-REM shallow/deep distinction, REM is not wakefulness, no medication/diagnosis.
Aging preserves chronic/multiple diseases, atypical symptoms and all listed system changes.
Dehydration preserves fluid restriction, dysphagia, medical recipient and no universal volume.
Constipation24–72h remains reference not diagnostic criterion; abdominaldiagram not massage procedure.
Edema/itch/insomnia uncertainty and physician/nurse coordination; no independent treatment choice.
aiReview.style: Respectful adult Chinese; no invented kinship, gender, diagnosis or clinical instructions; exact source roles, conditions and prohibitions preserved.

limits: AI editorial translation only. No independent language/domain/native/device/rights/release approval.
Record counts do not establish exhaustive unique source-knowledge coverage.
Existing figure lettering and image/device review limitations remain; artwork/UI unchanged.
